scripts.check:web: npm run check --workspace=@pi-console/web && npm run check --workspace=@pi-console/server && npm run check:desktop
scripts.build: cd packages/chord && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../codemode && npm run build && cd ../mcp && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../durable && npm run build
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/chord && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../codemode && npm run build && cd ../mcp && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../durable && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:runtime-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:kernel-boundaries && npm run check:entry-graphs && tsc --noEmit && npm run check:web

scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts

scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
